decisions.rationale: Follow-up to the loop-3 escalation in coding-lab-loop3-reconciliation.json. That record escalated edu-err-s1 only because workflow.md 2.4 allows two correction loops; it confirmed the finding (t6 required the exact "Loading services..." while t5 accepts /Loading services/) and recommended, as option A, a one-line test-only change at t6 line 45. Firstmate decision react-edu-err-s1-loop3 (2026-11-18) adopted option A. The reconciler verified the implementation at HEAD 99301d11. Commit cbd4f683 ("fix(react): match t6 loading text the way t5 does in the effects lab", message citing react-edu-err-s1-loop3) changes exactly one line, in tests/t6-abort-on-unmount.test.jsx: getByText("Loading services...") becomes getByText(/Loading services/). The current t6 sha256 is f5fc25c2..., and git diff cbd4f683..HEAD touches no file under react/effects-routing-and-rendering. lab.json is unchanged (sha256 cb6a3aa0...): failingTests, expected output, objectives and minutes are untouched. The private solved run is re-recorded at that commit in coding-lab-solved-run.json ("solved at cbd4f6837f9d46d189b5d492eb8aa8b5a34e52b8 by run solved-1794990221"). The education loop-3 recheck, coding-lab-loop3-critic-education-recheck.json (recheck.of coding-lab-critic-education.json), marks edu-err-s1 resolved against t6 sha256 f5fc25c2... with no new findings. Before the escalation, the reconciler verified the same change on a scratch copy: the solution passes 8/8, a typographic-ellipsis wording passes t5 and t6, the sme-err-r1 mutant still fails t6 at the no-error check, and the shipped starter still fails t6. The finding is resolved as decided.
